help.title: User guide
help.lead: Everything you need to connect Instagram, run scans, and read the results.
help.what.title: What does Instree do?
help.what.p1: Instree watches your Instagram mutual friends (people you follow who follow you back) and detects when their following lists change.
help.what.p2: After each scan you see who followed or unfollowed among your mutuals, who joined or left your own list, and you can explore links in the graph.
help.tokens.title: Connect Instagram (tokens)
help.tokens.intro: Instree needs two values copied from your browser while you are logged into Instagram. These are not your password — they are temporary session tokens.
help.tokens.step1: Open instagram.com in Chrome, Firefox, or Edge and sign in to your account.
help.tokens.step2: Press F12 (or right-click → Inspect) to open developer tools.
help.tokens.step3: Go to the Application tab (Chrome / Edge) or Storage tab (Firefox).
help.tokens.step4: In the left menu: Cookies → https://www.instagram.com
help.tokens.step5: Copy the value of the cookie
help.tokens.step6: Copy the value of the cookie
help.tokens.step7: Go to Settings, paste both values, click Verify connection, then Save.
help.tokens.webNote: Instree cannot read your browser remotely — you must paste the tokens yourself. After saving, the first scan (baseline) starts automatically.
help.tokens.desktopNote: Instree may read Chrome, Edge, or Firefox automatically. If that fails, paste the tokens manually as above.
help.tokens.security: Never share these tokens — they grant access to your Instagram account like a password. If you sign out of Instagram or change your password, copy new tokens.
help.home.title: Home page
help.home.intro: Main page: start a scan, browse history, and read detected changes.
help.home.webSchedule: On the server, scans run on their own every night (around 2 a.m.). You cannot start a manual scan here — that is expected.
help.home.webBaseline: After saving your Instagram tokens, Instree starts a baseline automatically. It downloads everything from scratch and can take a long time.
help.home.scanBtn: Compares your mutual list and each tracked person's following list. Use this for regular scans.
help.home.baseline: Clears history and starts from zero. Use only the first time or when you want to re-download everything. Very slow.
help.home.stopScan: Stops the current scan. Instree can resume later where it left off.
help.home.history: List of all past scans. Click a row to show its results.
help.home.nav: Move between the previous and next scan in history.
help.home.search: Type @username to filter the change list. If the person is not on this scan, Instree shows which scans include them.
help.home.legendListAdd: Someone joined or left your own mutual list.
help.home.legendAdd: One of your mutuals followed someone.
help.home.legendRemove: One of your mutuals unfollowed someone.
help.home.legendMutual: The person is already in your mutual list.
help.home.legendFilter: Click a symbol at the bottom of the page to show only that type of change.
help.graph.title: Graph page
help.graph.intro: Visualize links between your mutuals: who follows whom, grouped by communities. Requires at least one scan with Watch who they follow enabled.
help.graph.search: Type @username to center the view on that person.
help.graph.fullscreen: Expands the graph for easier exploration.
help.graph.panel: On the right: hide groups, adjust node size, link opacity, number of groups, etc.
help.graph.fit: Reframes the graph to fit everything on screen.
help.settings.title: Settings page
help.settings.intro: Configure Instagram connection and scan behavior.
help.settings.test: Tests your Instagram tokens before saving. You should see Connected as @….
help.settings.save: Saves all settings. If tokens are already saved, leave the fields empty to keep them.
help.settings.mutuals: MAX = all mutuals. A number (e.g. 50) limits the scan to the first N.
help.settings.watchN: How many follows Instree checks per mutual. MAX = the full list.
help.settings.watchFollowing: Required for the graph. Off = faster, but no links between mutuals.
help.settings.skipUnchanged: Speeds up later scans by skipping mutuals whose list did not change.
help.settings.schedule: Runs a scan every X minutes while Instree is open on your PC.
